propositions: After a successful new-writer save, last_get_pass must be absent from bindings.json and the chronological maximum must be persisted in get_rotation.json while rotation order is preserved across reload.

When get_rotation.json persistence fails open, the primary bindings.json save must succeed with the latest inline fallback retained, and the next successful save must promote the maximum to the sidecar and scrub the inline field.

A process failure after successful sidecar persistence but before bindings.json replace must retain the chronological maximum in the sidecar, allowing a fresh reload to observe the same maximum and a later retry to converge to sidecar-only form.

The BindingStore.save() method must merge staged inline values into in-memory sidecar using chronological max, atomically persist get_rotation.json, and only remove inline last_get_pass values after sidecar persistence succeeds.

A legacy writer introducing a later inline timestamp followed by a new writer must migrate that maximum into get_rotation.json, remove the inline field, and produce the same subsequent rotation order as an all-new sequence.
